profile.name: Nurazizah Zahrah
profile.title: Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
profile.tagline: Architecting clean, scalable systems with PHP, Laravel & Modern JavaScript
profile.career_objective: To leverage full-stack engineering skills, cross-functional operational experience, and rigorous problem-solving to architect impactful digital solutions for forward-thinking organizations.
profile.bio_short: Software Engineer with expertise in PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, MySQL, and cross-functional business operations.
profile.bio_full: I build software that bridges human need and technical precision. Having hands-on vocational engineering education paired with multi-departmental corporate internship experience, I approach software not just as code, but as operational infrastructure that drives real-world outcomes.

hero.headline: Engineering systems with purpose, precision & longevity.
hero.lead: I design and build robust web applications with PHP, Laravel, and modern JavaScript u2014 turning complex business processes into intuitive, elegant digital infrastructure.

faq.question: What is your primary technology stack?
faq.answer: My core stack is PHP with the Laravel framework for the backend, complemented by MySQL for database design and management. On the frontend, I build with semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 (including Tailwind CSS), and JavaScript (ES6+).

faq.question: Are you available for full-time employment or internships?
faq.answer: Yes! I am actively open to junior software engineer, backend developer, and full-stack developer opportunities where I can contribute to mission-critical systems and continue growing alongside experienced engineering mentors.

faq.question: What distinguishes your approach from other junior developers?
faq.answer: Beyond code, I have real multi-departmental corporate internship experience across HR, Accounting, Warehouse, and Production. This gives me a natural business empathy: I understand the human workflows behind data structures.
